methods.outcomes: Read saved full-grid aggregate results; no model or simulation rerun and no empirical input.
methods.scope: All72 fixed records,864 primary contrasts,216 pair records and567 early-time records; preserve12 duplicate k1 initialization pairs.
methods.zero_band_interpretation: Frozen numerical agreement scale reused descriptively, not a statistical test, detection threshold or biological null estimate. Analytic identities establish exact nulls where stated.
methods.coefficient_variation_metric: (max_T A_T-min_T A_T)/max_T A_T; descriptive numerical-zero band1e-8.
methods.feasibility_status: Post-results descriptive calculation, not preregistered power analysis; no calibrated physical time, uncertainty propagation or empirical effect size.
methods.no_new_threshold_or_case_selection: Every case and smallest-epsilon positive-leading row retained; extrema labeled descriptive.

early_event_feasibility.tag_scheme: One independent fair chronological tag per prospective founder. For complete-tree integrated U, this is expected weighted mass rather than a directly counted binary event.

scientific_claims: Horizon noninvariance and its sign are not specific to inherited persistence; nonexponential independent renewal can produce either sign across declared timer families.
All24 positive-death transmitted-type cases have positive sister covariance at all3 lags within this grid; homogeneous and rho0 iid clocks have analytic zero covariance.
Calendar birth-time mixing produces positive raw covariance without inherited type; known birth-specific residual expectation is zero.
Newborn leading-coefficient agreement across horizons does not imply full-curve invariance; uniform-stage initialization creates horizon-varying coefficients without transmission.

Positive-death signal separation within this grid is not universal: zero death, equal subtree-survival functions, unknown initial age, shared environment and observation dependence create blind spots or alternatives.
Permanent shared family environment with identical conditional tree laws is exactly observationally equivalent to perfectly inherited type.
Early-time order is a local selection-and-division statement, not a biochemical stage count, global lifetime distribution, assay, treatment target or clinical finding.
next_use: Use as a falsifiable observation-model stress test with explicit prospective founder and pair rosters, before empirical inheritance claims.
Prefer full finite-time joint patterns with founder-cluster uncertainty; treat near-zero asymptotics as structural checks until independently designed sampling feasibility is established.
For a future study, freeze power/robustness checks across plausible age uncertainty, shared calendar/context and recording loss before new outcomes; no outcomes from that study are generated here.
If mechanism separation is the aim, require measured context or interventions that break the permanent-family-environment equivalence; additional tree statistics alone cannot do so universally.
priority_and_external_claim_status: Bounded prior-art audit found close methods; no first-ever, new cancer mechanism, refutation of Iyer or clinical-target claim.

untested_combined_alternative.description: The fixed grid separates age-dependent renewal and shared-calendar mixing controls. Their no-transmission combination is not covered; any claim about its joint contrast/covariance needs a separately frozen analysis.
